dialogue.origin: (こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間がきたら始めさせていただきます。)
dialogue.content: (Hello. Thank you for coming today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: はい、承知いたしました。こちらこそ、お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: やる気が出ない
dialogue.content: I don't have any motivation.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、それは辛いですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see... That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にお聴きしてもよろしいですか?
dialogue.content: May I ask you about it in more detail?

dialogue.origin: コロナ禍で成績下がったし益々勉強したくなくなったし、
dialogue.content: Because of the pandemic, my grades dropped, and I feel even less like studying.

dialogue.origin: やる気でない
dialogue.content: I just don't have any motivation.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、それは悩ましいですね、、、
dialogue.content: I see... that must be very troubling.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yeah...

dialogue.origin: コロナでどのような事を感じられましたか?
dialogue.content: What kind of things did you feel during the pandemic?

dialogue.origin: 休校も多かったし、自学もやる気でなかったし、
dialogue.content: There were a lot of school closures, and I didn't have the motivation to study on my own.

dialogue.origin: わかるわけない
dialogue.content: There was no way I could understand it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。それは腹が立ってしまうかもしれませんね、、
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been frustrating.

dialogue.origin: もう、勉強したくない
dialogue.content: I just don't want to study anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。それぐらい悩んでいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. It sounds like this has been weighing on you a lot.

dialogue.origin: みんな、うっせーし。
dialogue.content: Everyone is so annoying.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、それはムカつきますよね、、
dialogue.content: I hear you... that would be really irritating.

dialogue.origin: そ、先生も、親も、うるさい
dialogue.content: Yeah, my teachers and my parents keep nagging me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。どのような事を言われたりしましたか?
dialogue.content: I see. What kinds of things have they been saying?

dialogue.origin: もっと頑張れとか、努力が足りないとか、
dialogue.content: Things like “Try harder,” or “You're not putting in enough effort.”

dialogue.origin: 親はダメ出しばっかり
dialogue.content: My parents are always criticizing me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、、それは腹が立ちますよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That must make you angry.

dialogue.origin: 勉強するやる気がなくなってしまうのも自然な事だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's natural to lose the motivation to study under those circumstances.

dialogue.origin: もうめんどくさい
dialogue.content: It's just too much trouble.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、お話の途中ですみませんが今日はどうお呼びすればよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... I'm sorry to interrupt, but how should I address you today?

dialogue.origin: こん”　でお願いします
dialogue.content: Please call me Kon.

dialogue.origin: こんさんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Kon, then. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんさんは休校中はどのように過ごされてましたか?
dialogue.content: Kon, how did you spend your time during the school closures?

dialogue.origin: ゲームしたり、
dialogue.content: Playing games,

dialogue.origin: うんうん(聴いていますね)
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. (I'm listening.)

dialogue.origin: スマホ見たり、たまにーに勉強
dialogue.content: Looking at my phone, and studying once in a great while.

dialogue.origin: 宿題だけちょっと
dialogue.content: Just a little bit of homework.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。過ごしていてどう思われましたか?
dialogue.content: I see. How did you feel about spending your time that way?

dialogue.origin: かったるい
dialogue.content: It all felt like a drag.

dialogue.origin: やる気でない
dialogue.content: I had no motivation.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。やる気も出ないし、気分も上がらないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. It's hard to feel motivated, and your mood doesn't lift either, right?

dialogue.origin: だいたい、なんで勉強なんかしなくちゃなんないわけ？
dialogue.content: I mean, why do we even have to study in the first place?

dialogue.origin: うーん、、何でなんでしょうか、、こんさんは勉強についてどう思っていますか?
dialogue.content: Hmm... why is that, I wonder... Kon, what are your thoughts on studying?

dialogue.origin: ただでさえこんなコロナの世の中で、勉強したところで、いったい俺たちにこれから、どうすれっていうのかわかんんぇ
dialogue.content: In a world like this with COVID, even if we study, I have no idea what we're supposed to do from here on out.

dialogue.origin: わかんねぇよ
dialogue.content: I just don't know.

dialogue.origin: 何したらいいのかもわかんない
dialogue.content: I don't even know what I'm supposed to do.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。不安にもなるし、焦る気持ちも出てきますよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. It makes you feel anxious, and you start to feel a sense of urgency, too.

dialogue.origin: 何がしたいのかもわかんない
dialogue.content: I don't even know what I want to do.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、悩みますよね、、
dialogue.content: I see... it's a lot to wrestle with.

dialogue.origin: こんさんはどうなったらいいなぁとお考えですか?
dialogue.content: How would you like things to be, Kon?

dialogue.origin: 考えてみたこともないけど…
dialogue.content: I've never really thought about it, but...

dialogue.origin: ずっと遊んで暮らしたい
dialogue.content: I'd like to just play and have fun for the rest of my life.

dialogue.origin: こんな相談ダメでしょ？
dialogue.content: This isn't the kind of thing I should be talking about, is it?

dialogue.origin: ダメなことは全然ないですよ。
dialogue.content: Not at all. There's nothing wrong with that.

dialogue.origin: こんさんが今それくらい腹が立っていることや悩んでらっしゃるのは伝わってきます。ここでは全部吐き出してもらって大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: I can tell how angry and troubled you are right now. It's okay to let it all out here.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいかわかんないよいろいろ言われても…
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do... even when people tell me all sorts of things...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。それは辛いですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. That must be hard.

dialogue.origin: どんなに言われても、やる気も出ないし、勉強もしたくない
dialogue.content: No matter what anyone says, I can't get motivated and I don't want to study.

dialogue.origin: 俺だって、困ってる
dialogue.content: I'm struggling too, you know.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。それは困りますよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. I can see how that would be a struggle.

dialogue.origin: こんさんはこの相談で一番悩んでいるのはどのような事だと思いますか?
dialogue.content: In this situation, what do you feel is your biggest concern, Kon?

dialogue.origin: やる気がわかないことかな
dialogue.content: I guess that I can't find any motivation.

dialogue.origin: やる意味もわかんないし、やる気がわかない
dialogue.content: I don't see the point in doing it, and I can't find any motivation.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。それでは一度ここで少し話を整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed?

dialogue.origin: すみません。整理してもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Excuse me, may I summarize?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんさんはコロナ禍で休校もあったこともあり勉強をやる気が起きなくなってしまっている。
dialogue.content: Kon, due in part to school closures during the pandemic, you've lost your motivation to study.

dialogue.origin: 周りもダメ出しをしてくるが、自分でも何をしたらいいか、何をしたいかが分からなくなってしまっていて、何で勉強をしなきゃいけないのかと感じておられる。
dialogue.content: People around you are critical, but you yourself have lost sight of what you should do or what you want to do, and you're questioning why you have to study at all.

dialogue.origin: そしてやる気がわかないことが一番の悩みだと感じておられる。このような感じでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: And you feel that your biggest problem is this lack of motivation. Does that sound about right?

dialogue.origin: はい、やる気が出ないです、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I can't get motivated. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。そうですねぇ、、今は学校には普通に登校できていますか?
dialogue.content: Thank you. Let's see... are you able to attend school normally right now?

dialogue.origin: 今は行ってるけど、またそのうち、どうせ、どうなるかわかんないよね…
dialogue.content: I'm going now, but before long—who knows what's going to happen anyway...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。確かにどうなるか分からないのは不安ですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. It's certainly unsettling not knowing what will happen.

dialogue.origin: こんさんはどうしてやる気を出したいと感じているのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: Kon, why is it that you feel you want to be motivated?

dialogue.origin: 先生や親がうるさいから、めんどくさくて、無視してきたけど、
dialogue.content: Because my teachers and parents are so annoying. It was a hassle, so I've been ignoring them, but...

dialogue.origin: 毎日だるいし
dialogue.content: ...and I feel sluggish every day.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、だるいのが嫌だから。
dialogue.content: Well, I hate feeling sluggish.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。毎日言われていると息が詰まりますし、だるく感じますよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. Being told the same things every day can feel suffocating, and it makes you feel sluggish, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 他には感じている事はありますか?
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you're feeling?

dialogue.origin: まぁ、確かに、ずっとこのままじゃやっていけないもんね
dialogue.content: Well, yeah, I guess I can't go on like this forever.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうお考えなんですね。こんさんが勉強にやる気を出せていた時はどういう感じでしたか?
dialogue.content: I see. So that's what you're thinking. What was it like when you did feel motivated to study?

dialogue.origin: そんな時ない。
dialogue.content: There was never a time like that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それでは勉強以外でやる気が出る事はありますか?
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, is there anything other than studying that you feel motivated to do?

dialogue.origin: ゲーム
dialogue.content: Games.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。ゲームと勉強の違いってどういう所でしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. What's the difference between video games and studying?

dialogue.origin: ゲームだとどんどんクリアしていけるし、できると楽しい。勉強じゃ、ないからね
dialogue.content: With games, you can clear levels one after another, and it's fun when you succeed. Studying isn't like that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。 勉強ももしかしたら似ているかも知れません。
dialogue.content: I see. Studying might be similar in some ways.

dialogue.origin: にてる？
dialogue.content: Similar?

dialogue.origin: はい。  こんさんは今やる気が出なくてやる気を出したいと言っていましたがやる気が出なくても良いと思いますし、
dialogue.content: Yes. You said you can't get motivated and want to feel motivated, but I think it's okay even if you don't feel motivated,

dialogue.origin: この環境の中でやる気が無くなるのは無理もないと思います。
dialogue.content: In this environment, I think it's completely understandable to lose your motivation.

dialogue.origin: まずは１日１ページや１日一問でもいいのでやる気が出なくても少しずつやってみるのもいいかもしれません。
dialogue.content: To start, perhaps you could try doing just a little bit, even if you don't feel motivated, like one page or one problem a day.

dialogue.origin: いかがですか?
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: やってみようとは思うけど、続けられないかも
dialogue.content: I think I'll try, but I might not be able to keep it up.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。出来ないときは無理しなくて良いですよ。
dialogue.content: I see. When you can't do it, you don't have to force yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: まずは自分のペースで少しずつで良いと思います。そして出来なかった時もそれは悪いことではないと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's fine to start small, at your own pace. And when you can't do it, I don't think that's a bad thing.

dialogue.origin: 毎日いきなり続けるのは難しい事なので出来なかった時より出来た時に目を向けてみるのはいかがでしょうか?
dialogue.content: It's difficult to suddenly start doing something every day, so how about we focus on the times you're able to do it, rather than when you're not?

dialogue.origin: できた時に？
dialogue.content: On the times I did it?

dialogue.origin: はい。もし１日でも１問出来た時には自分を褒めてあげるのもやる気を出すには大事かもしれません。
dialogue.content: Yes. If you manage to do even one problem in a day, praising yourself for it might be an important step toward building motivation.

dialogue.origin: 自分を褒めるの？
dialogue.content: Praise myself?

dialogue.origin: はい。ゲームのクリアと同じで少しずつ進めて出来た事を自分でしっかり褒めて認めてあげれば少しずつ楽しくなっていくのではないかなと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes. Just like clearing a level in a game, if you make a little progress and then properly praise and acknowledge yourself for it, I think it might gradually become more enjoyable.

dialogue.origin: そっか、分かりました
dialogue.content: Oh, okay. I understand.

dialogue.origin: もし、どうしても出来なくて悩んだり、周りから何か言われて嫌な気持ちになったりしたらまたいつでも相談に来ていただいて大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: If you find you really can't do it and it's bothering you, or if people around you say things that upset you, please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。そしたら、また来ますね
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you. In that case, I'll come again.

dialogue.origin: はい。こちらこそありがとうございました。他にご相談はございますか?
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you as well. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: No, that's all. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい。それでは本日の相談を終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Alright. In that case, we'll conclude today's session. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: (本日はありがとうございました。長くなってしまってすいません。感じた事是非評価に書いてもらえたらと思います。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today. I'm sorry it went on a bit long. I'd appreciate it if you could write your feedback in the evaluation.)

dialogue.origin: (大変良い勉強をさせていただきました。ありがとうございました。こちらこそ、遅くまで、ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (This was a very good learning experience for me. Thank you. And thank you as well for staying so late.)

dialogue.origin: (失礼いたします)
dialogue.content: (Goodbye.)

dialogue.origin: (それで失礼します。)
dialogue.content: (Goodbye then.)

topic.sub: 勉強のやる気が出ない理由
